questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 가장 적절한 것은?

Doyle used a real hotel, which ____________ before Holmes was created.
questions.explanation: 과거 완료 수동태 형태가 필요합니다. 'Holmes was created'보다 이전에 호텔이 지어졌으므로 had been built가 정답입니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 동사의 형태로 가장 적절한 것은?

The talk show __________ before I turned on the TV.
questions.explanation: 과거 완료 시제가 필요합니다. TV를 켠 것보다 이전에 토크쇼가 시작되었으므로 had started가 정답입니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

I ____________ my homework when my mom came home.
questions.explanation: 과거 완료 시제가 필요합니다. 엄마가 집에 온 시점보다 이전에 숙제를 마쳤으므로 had finished가 정답입니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

When I arrived at school, the first class __________.
questions.explanation: 과거 완료 시제가 필요합니다. 학교에 도착한 것보다 이전에 첫 번째 수업이 이미 시작되었으므로 had already begun이 정답입니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 모두 고르면?

Judy __________ a ballerina before she became a teacher.
questions.explanation: 과거 완료 시제가 필요합니다. 교사가 되기 전에 발레리나였으므로 had been이 정답입니다.

questions.question:
다음 문장에서 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

When I met her at the park, she wasn't wearing the watch. I thought she __________ it.
questions.explanation: 과거 완료 시제가 필요합니다. 만난 시점보다 이전에 시계를 잃어버렸다고 생각했으므로 had lost가 정답입니다.

questions.answer: I had lost my watch that my father had bought me
questions.question:
<보기>의 단어를 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오.

<보기> lost  my  my  bought  father
       had  me  watch

I ____ ____ (A)____ that ____ ____
____ ____ ____
questions.explanation: 주어진 단어(lost, my, my, bought, father, had, me, watch)를 모두 사용하여 과거완료 문장을 만듭니다. "I had lost my watch that my father had bought me" = 나는 아버지가 나에게 사준 시계를 잃어버렸었다.

options: it was rained during the night
it has rained during the night
it had rained during the night
it has been raining during the night
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?

It rained during the night. The road was wet.
= The road was wet because ______________.
questions.explanation: 과거 완료 시제가 필요합니다. 길이 젖은 것(과거)보다 이전에 밤새 비가 내렸으므로 it had rained during the night이 정답입니다.

questions.question:
다음 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

I (A)__________ my sister the book this morning which I (B)__________ three weeks before.
questions.explanation: (A)는 과거 시제 gave (this morning은 과거 표현), (B)는 과거 완료 시제 had bought (gave보다 3주 전)가 필요합니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸 (a), (b)에 들어갈 말이 차례대로 짝지어진 것은?

• She (a)__________ me since she went to New York.
• Minho couldn't open the door because he (b)__________ his key.
questions.explanation: (a)는 과거부터 현재까지 계속된 상황이므로 현재 완료 hasn't phoned, (b)는 문을 열 수 없었던 것보다 이전에 열쇠를 잃어버렸으므로 lost (또는 had lost, 하지만 더 간단한 형태)가 정답입니다.

questions.question:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 영작할 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

그녀가 돌아왔을 때 그는 이미 점심을 먹는 것을 마친 상태였다.
→ He (A)__________ lunch when she (B)__________ in.
questions.explanation: (A)는 그녀가 온 것보다 이전에 점심을 마쳤으므로 had finished, (B)는 과거 시점이므로 came이 정답입니다.

questions.question:
다음 우리말을 영작할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

그 여자는 전에 그의 친구가 추천해준 책을 샀다.
= She (A)__________ the book that her friend (B)__________ to her before.
questions.explanation: 두 행동이 같은 과거 시점에 일어났으므로 둘 다 단순 과거 시제 bought와 recommended가 정답입니다.

options: When I had got to the lecture, it has already ended.
When I got to the lecture, it had already ended.
When I get to the lecture, it has already ended.
When I had got to the lecture, it already ended.
When I got to the lecture, it had already end.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?

내가 강의에 도착했을 때, 강의는 이미 끝났다.
questions.explanation: 주절에서 과거 완료(had already ended), 종속절에서 과거 시제(got)를 사용해야 합니다. 옵션 2가 정확한 문법입니다.

questions.question:
다음 (a), (b)에 들어갈 알맞은 말이 차례대로 연결된 것은?

• Before he moved to America, David (a)__________ three books about women's mentality. (*mentality: 심리, 사고방식)
• She realized that she (b)__________ her purse in the department store.
questions.explanation: (a) 미국으로 이사가기 이전에 책을 썼으므로 had written, (b) 지갑을 잃어버린 후 깨달았으므로 had lost가 정답입니다.

options: had seen  /  anything active   /  had broken
had seen  / active anything   /  has broken
questions.question:
다음의 빈칸 (a)~(c)에 들어갈 알맞은 말이 차례대로 짝지어진 것은?

• My sister said she (a)__________ the movie before.
• By the time I get home, I'm too tired to do (b)__________.
• When Minho came back home, he found that his cat (c)__________ the flower pot.
questions.explanation: (a) '말했다'는 과거이지만 영화를 본 것은 그보다 이전이므로 had seen, (b) 구문은 'anything + 형용사' 순서이므로 anything active, (c) '집에 온 후 발견했으므로' had broken이 정답입니다.

questions.question:
다음의 빈칸 (a)~(c)에 들어갈 알맞은 말이 차례대로 짝지어진 것은?

• Judy had nothing to eat because Anne (a)__________ the whole cake.
• When Judy (b)__________ Jervis again, he had lived in Seoul for four years.
• Anne opened the box after she (c)__________ to the house.
questions.explanation: (a) 먹을 게 없었던 것보다 이전에 케이크를 먹었으므로 had eaten, (b) 4년을 살았던 상태를 설명하므로 had met, (c) 상자를 연 후 집에 도착했으므로 had got이 정답입니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 가장 적절한 단어를 고르시오.

• He had bought me a watch, but I (a)__________ it the next day.
• Who is that woman? I (b)__________ her before.
• The house was dirty. They (c)__________ it for weeks.
questions.explanation: (a) 과거 사건이므로 lost, (b) 현재까지의 경험이므로 have never seen, (c) 과거에 청소하지 않은 상태가 계속됐으므로 hadn't cleaned가 정답입니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸 (a)과 (b)에 가장 적절한 단어 쌍은?

When Minsu came home, he found that somebody (a)__________ the window and (b)__________ his coat.
questions.explanation: 민수가 집에 온 시점보다 이전에 창문이 깨지고 코트가 도난당했으므로 둘 다 과거 완료 시제인 had broken과 had stolen이 정답입니다.

options: When I had arrived at the party, Jason already went home.
When I have arrived at the party, Jason had already gone home.
When I arrived at the party, Jason had already gone home.
When I arrived at the party, Jason had already went home.
When I have arrived at the party, Jason had already went home.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 상황을 한 문장으로 바르게 설명한 문장을 고르면?
I arrived at the party at 3 o'clock yesterday. Jason wasn't there. He went home at 2:30.
questions.explanation: 내가 도착했을 때(과거)는 제이슨이 이미 떠난 후(과거 완료)이므로 'When I arrived at the party, Jason had already gone home'이 정답입니다.

options: Jiho did not have any books. + Jiho lost his backpack. → Jiho had losed his backpack, so he didn't have any books.
Hana missed the train. + She got up late. → Hana had missed the train because she has gotten up late.
Did Amy study French? + She moved to France. → Has Amy studied French when she moved to France?
He just finished lunch. + She opened the door. → Lunch had just finished by him when she opened the door.
I played soccer with my friends. + I joined the soccer club. → I had played soccer with my friends before I joined the soccer club.
questions.question: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 연결한 것은?
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 문장의 결과가 두 번째 문장의 원인이므로, 선행 동작인 '백팩을 잃어버렸다'를 나타내기 위해 'had lost'를 사용합니다.

options: I had never met her until I went to her house.
I had lost my book and couldn't study English.
He had taught in high school for 2 years before he came to Korea.
John had been in the classroom for 3 hours when I came back.
When I arrived at the restaurant, the food had already been ordered.
questions.question:
다음 중 주어진 문장과 같은 과거완료 용법이 쓰인 것은?

Tom told me he had been to China.
questions.explanation: Tom told me는 과거이고, 'had been to China'는 그보다 이전의 경험을 나타냅니다. 옵션 1의 'had never met'도 '갔다'는 시점보다 이전의 경험을 나타내므로 같은 용법입니다.

options: He has gone to Paris before I got back.
She had lived here for ten years until now.
I had found some books that he had left.
Yesterday I read the book which I had bought a week before.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: 옵션 5는 '어제'와 'had bought a week before'로 명확한 시간 관계가 성립합니다. 다른 옵션들은 시제 사용이 부적절합니다.

options: I found out somebody had eaten my cake.
I have known my teacher for a long time.
When she went out, the snow had already stopped.
I missed the bus because I have got up late.
I have just finished my homework.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 옵션 1은 '알아차렸다'는 과거보다 이전에 '먹었다'는 사건이 일어났으므로 과거 완료 had eaten이 올바릅니다.

options: I called my mom yesterday. She has been sick since last month.
They were tired. They had not slept for 24 hours.
When I arrived at the theater, the movie was already begun.
I didn't know who he was. I have never seen him before.
He realized that he left his keys in the room.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: 옵션 2의 'had not slept for 24 hours'는 그들이 피곤해진 것보다 이전의 상태를 설명하므로 과거 완료가 올바릅니다.

options: He lives in Busan before he moved here.
I returned the book that I had borrowed from him.
The concert had already finished when she got there.
When she got to the terminal, the bus had already left.
When we got home, we found somebody had broken the chair.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 옵션 2는 '돌려주었다'는 과거보다 이전에 '빌렸다'는 사건이 있으므로 had borrowed가 올바릅니다.

options: I lived in Busan before I had moved here.
Jake finished his work already when his boss came back to the office.
Sarah and I had been best friends since we were young.
The man had noticed me since he met me once before.
I had already spoken English before I was 14.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: 옵션 3은 'had been best friends since'로 과거 어느 시점부터 지속된 상태를 나타내므로 올바릅니다.

options: I was really full because I had had lunch.
I had drunk coffee before I went to bed.
I lost the watch that my brother had bought for me.
I didn't know him because I had never seen him before.
When I arrived at school, the first period had already began.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 옵션 4는 '몰랐다'는 과거보다 이전에 '본 적이 없었다'는 상태가 있으므로 had never seen이 올바릅니다.

options: Mary lost the book which I had been given to her.
When I entered the classroom, my English teacher had already started her class.
They have been standing for an hour before the meeting started.
I couldn't see the beautiful vase because his daughter broken it.
When Sarah came back home, she found that someone has cleaned her room.
questions.question: 다음 중 문법적으로 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 옵션 2는 '들어왔을 때'(과거)보다 이전에 '수업을 시작했다'(과거 완료)는 시간 관계가 올바릅니다.

options: He said that he had read the book.
The meeting had already begun when I got there.
I don't have any money because I had lost my wallet.
Had you ever seen the musical before I gave you the ticket?
She had lived there for ten years before she got married.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 'said'라는 과거 시점에서 'had read'는 그보다 이전의 경험을 나타내므로 올바릅니다.

options: She has worked here before she retired.
She just left the room when the police arrived.
He has moved five times since he came here.
Jina realized that she has left her key in the room.
When I arrived at school, the class already begins.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: 'came here'는 과거이고, 'has moved five times since'는 그 이후로부터 현재까지의 반복된 경험이므로 올바릅니다.

options: Tom looks so tired. He must have played soccer all day.
Jiho had played tennis after he finished his homework.
When Marianne got to the theater, the movie had already started.
Betty didn't come to school yesterday. She must have been sick.
Amy is not answering her cell phone. She must have left her phone home.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 옵션 1은 '지쳐 보인다'는 현재 상태에 대해 'must have played'로 추측을 표현하므로 올바릅니다.

options: When I had gone to the bus stop, the bus already left.
Because I had woken up late, I had to run to the bus stop.
Since I had recognized the girl at once, I had met her before.
By the time I had arrived at the party, my friends already went home.
Even though he had been late for class, there is no one in the classroom.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 또는 의미상 모두 올바르게 쓰인 문장은?
questions.explanation: 옵션 2는 '늦게 일어난 것'(과거 완료)이 '버스정거장에 달려가야 한다'는 결과의 원인이므로 올바릅니다.

options: David *had already left* when I got there.
After the guests *had left*, I went to bed.
I lost the pen that Amy *had bought* for me.
He *had broken* his leg, so he couldn't play soccer.
He asked me to fix the machine that *has broken* down.
questions.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 옵션 5의 'has broken'은 '고쳐달라고 요청한 과거'보다 이전에 깨진 상태를 나타내야 하므로 'had broken'이 올바릅니다.

options: When I arrived at the station, the train *had just left*
Before I went to bed, I *had written* in my journal.
Everybody *had already finishes* dinner when Kelly arrived at home.
The man *had broken* into five houses before the police caught him.
When I got there, the meeting *had already started.*
questions.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 옵션 3의 'had already finishes'는 'had already finished'로 수정되어야 합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 (A), (B)를 어법상 바르게 바꾼 것은?

I woke up late this morning, so I hurried to the bus stop. Unfortunately, the bus (A)leave when I (B)arrive at the bus stop. I missed the bus. That's why I was late for school.
questions.explanation: 버스정거장에 도착했을 때 버스는 이미 떠난 상태였으므로 'had left'와 'arrived'가 올바릅니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 가장 적절한 것은?

Yesterday, I studied late at night. So, I woke up late today. Therefore, I left home too late to take the bus on time. I had to run to the bus stop. However, when I got there, the bus (A)________. I got there too late to take the bus. When I finally (B)________ at school, the first class had started. I arrived too late to be on time for the first class.
questions.explanation: (A) 도착했을 때 버스는 이미 떠난 상태이므로 'had left', (B) '마침내 학교에 도착했을 때'라는 단순 과거이므로 'arrived'가 올바릅니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 총 개수는?

• She had lived there for five years  before she get marrried.
• She has never eat kimchi before she moved to Korea last year.
• I don't know who he is. I have never seen him before. 
• I had just put the clothes out when it started to rain. 
• When Susan arrived at the station, Jane already went home.
questions.explanation:
• She had lived there for five years before she gets married. (→ got married - 오류)
• She has never eat kimchi before she moved to Korea last year. (올바름)
• I don't know who he is. I have never seen him before. (올바름)
• I had just put the clothes out when it started to rain. (올바름)
• When Susan arrived at the station, Jane already went home. (→ had already gone - 오류)
올바른 문장은 2, 3, 4번으로 3개입니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?

a. Andrea had finished dinner before kris got home.
b. When  Stacy had gotten home yesterday, her brother ate all the cookies.
c. I hadn't known the news when I met her.
d. He insisted that he hasn't stolen any paintings.
e. The bus had left when we arrived at the bus stop.
f. He said he had already finished his homework.
g. I found out that she has lost her umbralla.
questions.explanation:
a. Andrea had finished dinner before Kris got home. (올바름)
c. I hadn't known the news when I met her. (올바름)
e. The bus had left when we arrived at the bus stop. (올바름)
f. He said he had already finished his homework. (올바름)

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 총 개수는?

•  I didn't know that she had seen the movie.
•  They had lived in Seoul before they moved to Tokyo.
•  I recognized the man at once since I had met him before.
•  The meeting had already finished when I had entered the meeting room.
•  The teacher would gotten angry because I hadn't done my homework.
•  She had never practiced the song before she sang it on the stage.
•  Sam never saw the beautiful beach before he had gone to the East Sea.
•  He had lost his wallet, so he couldn't have pay the taxi driver yesterday.
questions.explanation:
• I didn't know that she had seen the movie. (올바름)
• They had lived in Seoul before they moved to Tokyo. (올바름)
